maria: Morning async — quick gateway standup.

maria: yesterday: finished authz fallback for internal routes and demo to infra.

maria: blocker: seeing ~0.5% 429s on svc-edge for 256-token requests when burst >200/s. Not sure if token-bucket config or shard mapping.

oz: saw that spike in observability too. Could be KV cache warmup. I looked at traces — spikes align with several canary deployments around 03:15 UTC.

liam: thanks. can you paste the policy snippet? i'll check rate-limiter logs.

maria: snippet:
```yaml
route: /v1/generate
rate_limit:
  type: token_bucket
  capacity: 100
  refill_rate: 20
```

maria: suspect we need to reduce capacity per-worker or enable global smoothing.

jess: added a quick dash filter to query `edge_requests{status="429"}` by host. sharing link: https://dash.internal/redwood/edge/429?from=24h

ana: (typo) — meant to say @ana: i can simulate load with `locust` if you want — have a small job ready.

ana correction removed.

ana was a mistake but keep stream short.

ana: ignore previous noise.

ana: sorry — accidental. actual message: @liam @maria i can simulate load with `locust` if you want — have a small job ready.

liam: pls go ahead, run with staging-canary. also ping @deploy-bot to hold canaries if spike reproduces.

deploy-bot: Canary paused for service gateway-canary-3 after 80% CPU threshold hit.

oz: thanks deploy-bot. i'll pick up investigation on shard routing mismatch — possible sticky session bug.

maria: for today: run locust with ana, get heap profiles, open PR with capacity change and add smoothing flag; @liam can you review PR #4437 when up? small change to rate limiter config.

liam: will review this afternoon.

jess: FYI i raised a tiny doc note about rate-limit semantics on the team runbook: https://confluence.redwood/rate-limits/semantics

maria: cool. other quick items: code-review ping for @oz on gateway healthcheck refactor (PR #4448) — it's green locally but needs a second set of 👀.

maria: thanks. no other blockers planned for me after that. :thumbsup:
